description: Offline deep diff of two saved library assets on disk (recipe JSONs, component manifests, or serialize-network spec JSONs). Reports added/removed keys and changed values (old to new); for recipes it also diffs nodes, per-node params, and connections. Does not touch TouchDesigner. Use diff_snapshots to compare two live TD graphs.

a_path.description: First saved library asset on disk (recipe / component manifest / spec JSON).

b_path.description: Second saved library asset to compare against the first (same kind).

mode.description: How to interpret both files. 'auto' picks by parsing (recipe-aware if both validate against the recipe schema, otherwise a generic deep diff). 'recipe' forces recipe-aware diffing (node/param/connection level). 'manifest' uses the same generic deep object diff as 'json' but reports mode_used='manifest' for component-manifest callers.

name: diff_library_assets
title: Diff library assets
